name: LYNX Cross Search
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt update && sudo xargs apt install -y < packages.txt; fi; python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

postAttachCommand.server: python -m streamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
